findings.message: Frozen CommandOutbox edge coverage is incomplete: add negative written-length handling, empty TryBuild false/default/0, and a payload that actually straddles the byte-ring boundary with repeated frozen multi-entry prefix builds. The current 20-byte payload with 140-byte capacity only wraps the tail exactly to zero.

MemoryTransport.BeginStep is not tested in Faulted state, although the frozen contract requires a no-op in every lifecycle state. Exercise a reliably faulted pair and prove that BeginStep preserves QueueOverflow and terminal receive behavior.

CommandDispatcher constructor coverage does not prove the complete frozen validation matrix and precedence: add null-first coverage and a rejected-only world to prove missing CommandAcceptedEvent handling before codec or authorizer access.
